title: Greenshot recipe catalog entry
description: catalog.json next to a recipe: what the catalog needs to list it. Not part of the recipe file, so changing it doesn't change what the user approved.

version.description: The version of this recipe (major.minor.patch). Goes up with every change of the recipe file.

minGreenshot.description: The oldest Greenshot version the recipe works with, e.g. 1.4.0.

summary.description: One line for the catalog overview.

tags.description: Lower case words for filtering, e.g. after-capture, editor, command-line, clipboard, qr-code.
